title: VWP Extension Fact-Type Registry
description: Canonical fact types an extension declares (FORMAT-GAPS Gap 2, format level): the conventional factType vocabulary and value shapes that make work products comparable across preparers and tools. Benchmark required-facts manifests bind slots to these types; platforms may seed starter manifests from entries marked `starter`.

slot.description: Conventional slot name for required-facts manifests.

starter.description: Include in a new engagement's starter manifest by default.
